user.title: Connect Control Hub
user.description: Enter your Firebase project details and a hub key. The hub key is a long random secret you choose (12+ characters) and also give to your app/site. Home Assistant signs in anonymously and claims it.

error.key_too_short: The hub key must be at least 12 characters.
error.invalid_auth: Firebase rejected the API key, or Anonymous sign-in is not enabled.
error.claim_failed: This hub key is already claimed by another user or is marked invalid.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Firebase. Check your network and the Realtime Database URL.

abort.already_configured: This hub key is already configured.
